description: P.P. Collina di Pinerolo (P. definitivo) - Fenomeni di dissesto is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cittametropolitana.torino.it. Identification of failure or hydrogeological hazards in the area covered by the Pinerolo Landscape Plan. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "P.P. Collina di Pinerolo (P. definitive) – Failure phenomena" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include piani paesistici, paesaggistici, dissesto idrogeologico, RNDT. The listing shows 2009-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
